stanza: Sugar Plum Fairy came and hit the streets
Looking for soul food and a place to eat
Went to the Apollo
You should've seen him go, go, go

follow.line: Where do you go when there’s no road to follow?
stanza: Where do you go when there’s no road to follow?
Faces look hollow, only strangers to you now
Where do you turn when this living starts to burn
Through layers that you learned to wrap around your heart somehow?
I turn to you
I always do
I turn to you

follow.line: When I go, don't you follow
stanza: When I go, don't you follow

follow.line: They will lose her if they follow
stanza: She will love them when she sees them
They will lose her if they follow
And she only means to please them
And her heart is full and hollow like a cactus tree
While she's so busy being free
When my hand's gone, you'll be the same
You're unlike anything I know
You're still the one that can't be tamed
Never convinced you to follow
Sheltered so you can't hear the blame
Oh, tell me how far should I go

follow.line: I'd be crazy not to follow
stanza: I'd be crazy not to follow
Follow where you lead
Your eyes
They turn me
Turn me into phantoms (Way out)
I follow to the edge (Way out)
Of the earth (Way out)
And fall off
Yeah, everybody leaves (Way out)
If they get the chance (Way out)
And this (Way out)
Is my chance
I want to know you
I want to show you
I want to be there
I want to see how
Piece us together
Know it's forever
Show me the future
Tell me you'll be there
I want to go where
Nobody knows fear
I want to follow
My heart down that wild road

follow.line: Where you lead, I will follow
stanza: Where you lead, I will follow
Anywhere that you tell me to
If you need, you need me to be with you
I will follow where you lead

follow.songTitle: Follow the Yellow Brick Road / You’re Off to See the Wizard
stanza: Follow the yellow brick road
Follow the yellow brick road
Follow, follow, follow, follow
Follow the yellow brick road
Don't let, don't let the lifestyle drag you down
Who knows when was the last time you felt the love
One last sparkle to follow in my light
One last sparkle to follow
The more that you say, the less I know
Wherever you stray, I follow
I'm begging for you to take my hand
Wreck my plans, that's my man
While the moon does its division
You're buried below
And you're coming up roses everywhere you go
Red roses follow

hollow.line: The hours grow heavy and hollow
stanza: The hours grow heavy and hollow
Cruel as a grave
Open me and you'll find
Only bones burned to glass
Last week, our picture window
Produced a half-word
Heavy and hollow
Hit by a brown bird

hollow.line: You can't be trusted with feathers so hollow
stanza: So I will opt for the big white limo
Vanity fairgrounds and rebel angels
You can't be trusted with feathers so hollow
You're heaven's invention, steel-eyed vampires of love
You see over me

swallow.line: I'll be over the water like a swallow
stanza: With a hired plane
And no names mentioned
Tonight's the night of the flight
Before you know
I'll be over the water like a swallow
There's no risk
I'll whisk them up in no moonlight
And though pigs can fly
They'll never find me posing as the night
And I'm home before the morning”
Waited for you till the snow fell down
Over my skin like a thin nightgown
Waited for you but you never came around at all
Waited for you till they pulled the plug
Bartender emptied out his big tip jug
They swept all the floors
Vacuumed the rugs and went home
Drank all I could swallow
Now the moon's gonna' follow me home

swallow.songTitle: Yankee Bayonet (I Will Be Home Then)
swallow.line: Soldier: Look for me when the sun-bright swallow
stanza: Soldier: Look for me when the sun-bright swallow
Sings upon the birch bough high
